title: Assurance D: a forged or incomplete decision proof does not pass
note: Each mutation weakens the independent verifier in agent_substrate/reconstruct.py: a claim not compared, a field omitted or invented unnoticed, or a condition of the decision -- accepted by the reader, separation of duties, evidence held and re-hashed, admission, dependencies standing, a granted and answered model call, a policy in force -- not checked.

mutations.name: DP1_a_changed_claim_is_not_compared
mutations.find:
if claim != derived:
        return [f"{path}: the proof says
mutations.replace:
if False:
        return [f"{path}: the proof says
mutations.rationale: a proof could claim any decider, outcome or evidence and still pass

mutations.name: DP2_an_omitted_field_is_not_noticed
mutations.find:
if k not in claim:
                out.append(f"{where}: missing from the proof")
mutations.replace:
if k not in claim:
                pass
mutations.rationale: a proof could leave out the proposal, the policy or the evidence it does not want checked

mutations.name: DP3_an_invented_field_is_not_noticed
mutations.find:
out.append(f"{where}: in the proof, and nowhere in the "
                           "history")
mutations.rationale: a proof could add a reviewer approval the history never recorded

mutations.name: DP4_a_refused_decision_is_proved
mutations.rationale: a transition the gates refused could be shown with a clean proof

mutations.name: DP5_the_proposer_may_decide
mutations.rationale: a proposer verifying its own claim would pass

mutations.name: DP6_missing_evidence_passes
mutations.rationale: a decision citing bytes nobody holds would pass

mutations.name: DP7_the_store_is_trusted_to_say_so
mutations.find:
return isinstance(data, bytes) and \
        hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest_
mutations.rationale: a store returning any bytes for a digest would make cited evidence held

mutations.name: DP8_an_unadmitted_result_passes
mutations.rationale: a scientific result not admitted under its policy would pass as verified

mutations.name: DP9_a_dependency_out_of_standing_passes
mutations.find: if decided and any(s not in _DECIDED_STATES for s in
mutations.replace: if False and any(s not in _DECIDED_STATES for s in
mutations.rationale: a decision resting on a stale dependency would pass

mutations.name: DP10_an_ungranted_call_passes
mutations.rationale: a proposal no granted, answered model call produced would pass

mutations.name: DP11_a_stale_policy_passes
mutations.rationale: a proposal asked under a superseded or withdrawn policy would pass

mutations.name: DP12_withdrawal_is_ignored
mutations.find: return not withdrawn and latest is not None and str(latest) == ver
mutations.replace: return latest is not None and str(latest) == ver
mutations.rationale: a withdrawn policy would still be in force

mutations.name: DP13_a_verdict_on_a_stale_record_passes
mutations.rationale: a verdict resting on a result that lost its standing would pass

mutations.name: DP14_a_verdict_with_no_basis_passes
mutations.rationale: a verdict that cites nothing would pass
